compos.summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a web browser with an error message. The URL bar shows an attempt to access "https://www.fedex.com/lite/lite-". A pop-up dialog box is in the center of the screen with the title "Connection problem." The error message within the dialog box reads "net::ERR_CACHE_MISS." There is an "OK" button at the bottom of the dialog box for the user to acknowledge and dismiss the error message. The status bar at the top of the screen shows various icons, including notifications, signal strength, battery level, and the current time (2:18).
